# CutScript (third_party)

OpenMontage vendors FFmpeg export helpers from **CutScript**, an MIT-licensed,
Descript-like open-source text-based video editor.

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/DataAnts-AI/CutScript
- **License:** MIT (see LICENSE)
- **Files:** `video_editor.py`, `audio_cleaner.py`

CutScript is not affiliated with Descript Inc. For Descript Inc.'s own open-source
libraries (e.g. `descript-audio-codec`, `audiotools`), see https://github.com/descriptinc.
